source_review_coverage: The coordinator accepted these local APK/source version pairs using reviewed current outputs, serialized export records, frozen main/Services and controlled-write history. Historical Android exports did not retain full pre/post source snapshots; older Powder/Room Web guards covered main and Services only. This is not a claim of reproducible cryptographic APK-to-source build binding.
metadata_scope: Public image provenance summary, not the original private capture validation receipt. PNG bytes and the recorded visual qualifications are unchanged.

runtime_approval.evidence: Recorded normal Android gameplay and offline save/restart checks were accepted with the limitations in docs/NATIVE_QA.json. This is dated local verification; production, physical-device, audible-audio and interactive-browser acceptance is not claimed.
